# Lab 25.6: Validate with the Data Validation Tool

## What We Are Going to Do
Use the open-source Data Validation Tool (DVT) to compare row counts, sums and checksums between a source table and its copy in BigQuery.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a "migrated" copy with a deliberate difference.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab25
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'CREATE TABLE lab25.orders_copy AS SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`'
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'DELETE FROM lab25.orders_copy WHERE MOD(order_id, 1000) = 0'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Install DVT and add a connection.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">pip install --quiet google-pso-data-validator
data-validation connections add --connection-name bq BigQuery --project-id $PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Compare counts and sums.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">data-validation validate column -sc bq -tc bq \
  -tbls bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders=$PROJECT_ID.lab25.orders_copy \
  --count '*' --sum num_of_item</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The result shows the source and target values and a **fail** status for the mismatch.

4. **[CLI] Row-level check on a key.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">data-validation validate row -sc bq -tc bq \
  -tbls bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders=$PROJECT_ID.lab25.orders_copy \
  --primary-keys order_id --hash '*' --filter-status fail | head -20</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] Save results to BigQuery.** Add `-rh $PROJECT_ID.lab25.dvt_results` to any command to write results to a table for reporting.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Column validation | Counts and sums compared |
| Row validation | Hash per row by primary key |
| Mismatch | Missing rows found |
| Sources | Teradata, Oracle, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery and more |
